slots.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: While the FBI listed hundreds of addresses in its notice, Chainalysis said the Binance attackers have already used "thousands addresses," and expects this number to continue growing.

slots.title: A stolen iPhone, $14,000 in losses and London's crypto theft problem
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Two strangers befriended Magnus Ahmad outside a London bar. Hours later, thieves had emptied his crypto wallets, accessed his bank accounts and disabled his laptop.

slots.title: Data centers are now a midterm issue, even in Brooklyn
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: At a Brooklyn midterm party five days before Election Day, every conversation, from a council member’s fireside chat to a debate about the Democratic Party, kept circling back to AI and data centers.

slots.title: Traders are already placing leveraged bets on Anthropic’s IPO using crypto contracts
